title: The output guard keeps the exit of merge --touches
why: hooks/guard_stream.py CHECK_FLAGS lacks `--touches`, so `merge --touches ... | tail` hides its exit 1, while `--release-check | tail` is refused. Harm: a coordinator reads a failed read as clear and starts a duplicate lane. Found by #2431 round 3 (reviewer sonnet, 2026-11-11 07:38 CST). Guard change, own lane, after #2431 lands.
